subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Ron is sitting second to the right of Ann. Brian is an immediate neighbour of both Luther and Ann. Eve is sitting third to the left of Luther. Who is sitting between Brian and Van?
solution:
**Given: **Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Ron is sitting second to the right of Ann. Brian is an immediate neighbour of both Luther and Ann.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca288f2711dc6ada9643d5d9ed2a26e55c9932bc5ebadcf7bcf14bc1ab3e2d6f.png] 

Eve is sitting third to the left of Luther.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0f39e226b46fe34cd9128b093f1c1c9e79422b2e4394a9e730dd7ff3099cb79.png] 

Thus, Luther is sitting between Brian and Van.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
